title: ALL Operator — Above All Department Averages
description: Find employees whose salary exceeds every department average using ALL.

data.text: Write a query to find employees whose salary is greater than the average salary of ALL departments.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Salary, Department
FROM Employees e
WHERE Salary > ALL (
    SELECT AVG(Salary)
    FROM Employees
    GROUP BY Department
)
ORDER BY Salary DESC;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: ALL compares a value against every value returned by the subquery. Salary > ALL(...) means salary is greater than the highest average department salary. Equivalent to Salary > (SELECT MAX(AvgSalary) FROM (...)). ANY is similar but uses OR logic.
